headline: Fully deployed content, staging and the Worker — and turned the uptime sampler from a permission nobody had re-tested into one named, quoted provider limit.

items.title: Edge uptime sampler: namespace + binding LIVE, cron REFUSED
items.insight: S350 held this on a founder allow that had already lapsed, and the KV namespace created on the first re-probe. The Worker deployed with UPTIME_SAMPLES bound live in production, then Cloudflare refused the cron with error 10072 because all five Workers Free account slots belong to other projects. No cron means no invoker, so the flag is back to 0 and the cron is commented out rather than left declared and failing every future deploy.
items.evidence: deployed script bindings via CF API; run 34667777146; error 10072

items.title: build-brand-assets could only ever destroy its own manifest
items.insight: BRAND_ROOT was the sanitized <user-home> literal with nothing expanding it, so every job skipped on every run and the caller wrote an empty manifest anyway at exit 0. The S350 sweep-repair incident was the only behaviour, not an edge case. Placeholder now expands at runtime; the writer refuses when any job was skipped.
items.evidence: scripts/build-brand-assets.mjs; 7/7 jobs build, every committed .png byte-identical; bad root exits 1 manifest-preserved

items.title: Three unit suites that no runner had ever executed
items.insight: test:unit declared five spec files, build:check ran two, and npm run test:unit was invoked by nothing anywhere. 16 tests were gated by no runner. They pass, so this armed an alarm rather than fixing a red.

items.title: The release verification step would have reported success draining nothing
items.insight: drain-uptime-kv.mjs read its namespace only from an env var nothing sets, so the documented way to verify this very release would have printed the sampler is not enabled yet and exited 0. It now resolves the namespace from the deployed binding.

items.title: Stale-shell matcher can no longer go dead silently
items.insight: S350 root-fixed a regex here that had never matched. The predicate is now exported, the live path routes through it, and a known-stale fixture must classify as stale — the only thing separating a working cleaner from a dead pattern, since both print no stale shell files found.

items.title: Caught pre-deploy: enabling uptime would have disabled the hub subdomain
items.insight: The first placement of the KV binding and cron sat between [env.production.vars] and the bare keys after it, re-parenting HUB_SUBDOMAIN_ENABLED and HUB_SESSION_TTL_SEC into [triggers]. Parsing the config caught what reading the edit did not.
items.evidence: wrangler dry-run: HUB_SUBDOMAIN_ENABLED=1, HUB_SESSION_TTL_SEC=2592000 in env.production.vars

items.title: A green workflow run that deployed nothing
items.insight: Both production workflows evaluate the promotion interlock on push, take a Promotion held branch that skips every deploy step, and still conclude success. The live apex was serving the previous content after a green run. Promotion was then done on the SCOPED path by explicit dispatch, staging first, and verified against served bytes rather than the run conclusion.
items.evidence: pages-deploy 34667065915 all deploy steps skipped; dispatch 34667221562 green; live days-since-launch 191 to 192

followUps: Founder decision: free one of the five account cron slots, or move to Workers Paid — everything downstream of it is built, deployed and verified.
Add a divergence gate for the declared vs executed unit-suite lists.
Make [skip ci] publishers cascade their own derived artifacts instead of taxing the next session.
Treat a green Actions run as necessary but never sufficient evidence of a deploy; assert served bytes.
blockers: Uptime sampler has no invoker: Workers Free 5-cron account cap, all five held by other projects (Cloudflare 10072). Founder frees a slot or moves to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable and age out naturally; never re-scored.
Identity/provider acceptance, newsletter arming, Desk cadence, public-member-data and warm-origin remain founder-gated.
